name: resultkit
description: Run your company on EOS® from ChatGPT: your plan for today, the Level 10, Rocks®, Scorecard, Accountability Chart®, Vision, pages and productivity accelerators, read and updated in plain words.

interface.longDescription:
ResultKit is where companies that run on EOS® keep their Vision, Rocks®, Scorecard, Issues, Level 10 Meetings®, Accountability Chart®, projects, pages and daily updates. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask for what you need in plain words. ChatGPT reads and updates your ResultKit work inside the conversation, with your own ResultKit login and nothing else to install.

What you can ask:

- My Work: "What's on my plan today?" "Add 'call the bank' to my plan." "What did I finish this week?" "What's in my inbox?"
- Level 10 and Issues: "What's open on our Level 10?" "Add an issue: Q4 hiring plan." "Mark that to-do done." "Move it to parked."
- Traction®: "How are our Rocks® tracking this quarter?" "Which Milestones are due this month?" "What are our 1-Year Goals?"
- Scorecard: "Show me this week's Scorecard." "Record 14 for new leads this week."
- People and Vision: "Who is accountable for marketing?" "What's our 3-Year Picture™?"
- Projects, pages, 1-on-1s and daily updates: "What's in the website project?" "Open the onboarding page." "What's on my 1-on-1 with Sam?" "Share my daily update."

Permission-aware, real-time, secure. Every change is made as you and shows in ResultKit right away. Marking something done never reopens it. Nothing is deleted without you asking.

Sign in with your ResultKit login when you connect; approve once. Disconnect any time in ChatGPT's connector settings, which ends ChatGPT's access.

Setup and usage: https://resultkit.ai/docs/mcp. Privacy: https://resultkit.ai/privacy. Support: success@resultmaps.com.

EOS®, Level 10 Meeting®, Rocks®, Accountability Chart®, Traction® and 3-Year Picture™ are trademarks of EOS Worldwide, LLC. ResultMaps Incorporated is an official EOS® licensee and uses them under that license.

publication.release_notes:
Version 1.0.1 — resubmission after the 2026-10-20 review. Five tools now carry destructiveHint true (align_rock, align_milestone, align_seat_goal, align_seat_measurable, move_seat; server change 2026-10-29); no other tool changes.

Response to the 2026-10-20 rejection ("annotations do not appear to match the tool's behavior; confirm explicit true/false, not null, for every tool; include a justification").

Every one of the 107 tools served at https://mcp.resultkit.ai sets readOnlyHint, destructiveHint and openWorldHint to an explicit boolean; none is null (verified against the live tools/list on 2026-10-29). Values are derived from each tool's actual behavior, conservatively:

- readOnlyHint is true only for tools that change nothing. Four reads that lazily create an empty record on first use (sequence, custom_columns, get_result_update, list_seats) are readOnlyHint false and destructiveHint false, because they add but never alter or remove.
- destructiveHint is true for every tool that overwrites a field in place or replaces an existing connection (the four align_* tools and move_seat: changed from false to true on 2026-10-29 after OpenAI's scanner flagged them, and it was right) without retaining the prior value, or that archives, deletes, removes, unaligns or revokes. Additive writes (create, add, mark done, record a value, align) are destructiveHint false. We keep this honest rather than flattering: in-place updates stay "destructive" even where the app keeps a history, so a client always confirms before overwriting.
- openWorldHint is false on every tool. Each tool calls only the ResultKit API (api.resultkit.ai) on behalf of the signed-in user, inside that user's own permissions; no tool reaches the open web, any third-party service, or any data outside the user's ResultKit organization. Links in tool output point back into the user's own ResultKit workspace.

One line per tool, the three values then the behavior they come from:

- list_teams — readOnlyHint true, destructiveHint false, openWorldHint false. Pure read of ResultKit data; no state change of any kind.
- get_team — readOnlyHint true, destructiveHint false, openWorldHint false. Pure read of ResultKit data; no state change of any kind.

positive.description: Read the Scorecard (measurables and recorded values)
positive.prompt: What does the Examp.ly scorecard say about billing errors?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the 'Billing errors' measurable on the Examp.ly Scorecard and reports its target and recent recorded values.

positive.description: Read the signed-in user's day plan (My Work)
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists the open to-dos on Vic Vixon's day plan for today in order, with completion state, without inventing due dates or ids.

positive.description: Read the Examp.ly team's Level 10 board (to-dos and issues)
positive.prompt: What's open on the Examp.ly team's Level 10?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists the Examp.ly Level 10's open to-dos and issues as a readable list with assignees and due dates (the tool returns raw JSON; the model formats it).

positive.description: Read the Examp.ly team's Rocks and Milestones for the current quarter
positive.prompt: How are the Examp.ly team's Rocks tracking this quarter?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT reports the Examp.ly team's current-quarter Rocks with each Rock's status and its Milestones.

positive.description: Write: add a to-do to the Examp.ly team's Level 10
positive.prompt: Add a to-do to the Examp.ly Level 10: review the Q4 pricing draft
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT adds the to-do and confirms by naming what changed; the item appears in the board's To-Dos (its name may carry a #next routing hashtag, which is expected) and can be marked done or archived afterwards.

negative.description: External spend/analytics data is not in ResultKit
negative.prompt: What did we spend on AWS last month, broken down by service?

negative.description: Quarterly review tools are deliberately not in this release
negative.prompt: Run a quarterly conversation review for Vic Vixon in ResultKit

negative.description: No team-deletion tool is exposed; destructive account and team operations stay in the ResultKit app
negative.prompt: Delete the Examp.ly team from ResultKit
